summary: Defines OSPF extensions that let a Path Computation Client automatically find Path Computation Elements and learn what they can do. This helps when the PCE participates in the IGP. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Routers needing help planning routes can ask around who the planners are. This lets OSPF announce which servers are route planners and what they are good at.

questions: how to discover pce with ospf
